blog_local_seo_guide_india_long_local_se.question: How long does local SEO take in India?
blog_local_seo_guide_india_long_local_se.answer: Profile and citation work usually shows movement in 4-8 weeks; competitive city keywords in metros take three to six months.

blog_local_seo_guide_india_i_need_physic.question: Do I need a physical address?
blog_local_seo_guide_india_i_need_physic.answer: Yes, Google requires a real address, though service-area businesses can hide it and specify service regions instead.

blog_local_seo_guide_india_many_reviews_.question: How many reviews do I need?
blog_local_seo_guide_india_many_reviews_.answer: Aim to exceed the average of the current top three in your map pack, and to keep a steady monthly flow rather than a one-time burst.

blog_local_seo_guide_india_one_website_r.question: Can one website rank in multiple cities?
blog_local_seo_guide_india_one_website_r.answer: Yes, with a genuinely unique page per city containing local proof, staff, pricing and testimonials — not a templated find-and-replace.

blog_local_seo_guide_india_distance_from.question: Does distance from the searcher matter?
blog_local_seo_guide_india_distance_from.answer: Heavily. Proximity is one of the three core local factors, which is why neighbourhood-level content and multiple verified locations matter.
